Jorbs Defect Tier List

The formula for winning with Claw is quite simple: Block with Relics or good Block cards while drawing through your deck for lots of Claws. All For One or Feral often win the run easily from there, but Claws can win even without them. Remember that a deck with 3+ Claws often would prefer card draw or block over another copy of Claw.
